notes.text: “A second team given only the talk's repository at 298be4e: no brief, no memo, no transcript, no contact.” (ch. 11, line 10)

“it had the editor's briefs, his corrections and, later, the talk as given.” (ch. 11, line 3)
“This team has the talk as given, added after the day (a9c0b49).” (ch. 11, line 77)
“Every chapter so far was written from inside.” (ch. 11, line 3)
